name: vp-xlsx
description: Lightweight and type-safe Excel (.xlsx) parser and processor powered by Vite+ and Zod

scripts.agent:verify:gate: npm run agent:verify:unit && npm run build
scripts.agent:verify:inner: npm run typecheck && npm run check
scripts.agent:verify:unit: npm run agent:verify:inner && npm run agent:test:unit
scripts.check:fast: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run agent:test:unit
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run check && npm test && npm run build
